SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM director_mapping) AS credit_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT name_id, movie_id FROM director_mapping)) AS distinct_credits,
    COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
    COUNT(m.id) AS matched_movies,
    COUNT(n.id) AS matched_names,
    COUNT(r.movie_id) AS matched_ratings,
    COUNT(julianday(m.date_published)) AS usable_dates,
    MIN(m.date_published) AS earliest_date,
    MAX(m.date_published) AS latest_date
FROM director_mapping AS d
LEFT JOIN movies AS m ON m.id = d.movie_id
LEFT JOIN names AS n ON n.id = d.name_id
LEFT JOIN ratings AS r ON r.movie_id = m.id

arguments.sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT
        d.name_id AS director_id,
        m.id AS movie_id,
        m.duration,
        julianday(m.date_published) - LAG(julianday(m.date_published)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.name_id
            ORDER BY m.date_published, m.id
        ) AS gap_days
    FROM director_mapping AS d
    JOIN movies AS m ON m.id = d.movie_id
)
SELECT
    dm.director_id,
    n.name AS director_name,
    COUNT(*) AS movie_count,
    CAST(ROUND(AVG(dm.gap_days)) AS INTEGER) AS avg_inter_movie_days,
    ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
    MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
    SUM(dm.duration) AS total_movie_duration
FROM director_movies AS dm
JOIN names AS n ON n.id = dm.director_id
LEFT JOIN ratings AS r ON r.movie_id = dm.movie_id
GROUP BY dm.director_id, n.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
